where.if: AND (A.PER_NO LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%' OR I.NAME LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%' OR A.DEPT_CODE LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%' OR D.SAMUSO_NAME LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%')

mapper.sql:
SELECT RTRIM(A.DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE, D.SAMUSO_NAME AS DEPT_NM, RTRIM(A.OFC_CODE) AS OFC_CODE, O.KANM, A.PER_NO, I.NAME, A.AUTH,
C.CODE_NM AS AUTH_NM,
NULL AS AUTH_NM,
RTRIM(A.APV_STS) AS APV_STS, A.MEMO, RTRIM(A.DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE, RTRIM(A.INS_DATE) AS INS_DATE, RTRIM(A.INS_ID) AS INS_ID, A.CRT_DTM, A.CRT_CMENO, A.LSCHG_DTM, A.LS_CMENO FROM TB_SCR_AUTH A LEFT JOIN TB_INSA I ON I.PER_NO = A.PER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_REG_MGT O ON O.OFC_CODE = A.OFC_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_RAW D ON D.SAMUSO = RTRIM(A.DEPT_CODE)
LEFT JOIN TB_CODE_DTL C ON C.CODE_SECT = #{authCodeType} AND C.CODE = A.AUTH
mapper.select: ORDER BY A.OFC_CODE, A.PER_NO, A.DEPT_CODE OFFSET #{s.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{s.limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCR_AUTH A LEFT JOIN TB_INSA I ON I.PER_NO = A.PER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_RAW D ON D.SAMUSO = RTRIM(A.DEPT_CODE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCR_AUTH WHERE DEPT_CODE = CAST(#{deptCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND PER_NO = #{perNo}

SELECT SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME, ONLINE_CODE FROM TB_OFC_RAW
SAMUSO LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR SAMUSO_NAME LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
ORDER BY SAMUSO FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME, ONLINE_CODE FROM TB_OFC_RAW WHERE SAMUSO = #{samuso}
SELECT R.SAMUSO, R.SAMUSO_NAME, R.ONLINE_CODE FROM TB_INSA I JOIN TB_OFC_RAW R ON R.SAMUSO = I.SAMUSO WHERE I.PER_NO = #{perNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCR_AUTH ( DEPT_CODE, OFC_CODE, PER_NO, AUTH, INS_DATE, INS_ID, APV_STS, MEMO, DUE_DATE, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{deptCode}, #{ofcCode}, #{perNo}, #{auth}, #{insDate}, #{insId}, #{apvSts}, #{memo}, #{dueDate}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCR_AUTH SET AUTH = #{auth}, APV_STS = #{apvSts}, MEMO = #{memo}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE DEPT_CODE = CAST(#{deptCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND PER_NO = #{perNo}
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM TB_SCR_AUTH WHERE
DEPT_CODE = CAST(#{k.deptCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND OFC_CODE = CAST(#{k.ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND PER_NO = #{k.perNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT X.AUTH,
C.CODE_NM AS AUTH_NM,
NULL AS AUTH_NM,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCR_AUTH U WHERE U.AUTH = X.AUTH) AS USER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU M WHERE M.AUTH = X.AUTH) AS MENU_COUNT FROM (SELECT AUTH FROM TB_SCR_AUTH UNION SELECT AUTH FROM TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU
UNION SELECT D.CODE FROM TB_CODE_DTL D JOIN TB_CODE_MASTER W ON W.CODE_SECT = D.CODE_SECT WHERE D.CODE_SECT = #{authCodeType} AND NVL(W.USED_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND LENGTH(D.CODE) <= 2
) X
LEFT JOIN TB_CODE_DTL C ON C.CODE_SECT = #{authCodeType} AND C.CODE = X.AUTH
WHERE X.AUTH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY X.AUTH

SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_TYPE, M.MENU_PATH, M.SORT_NO, M.USE_YN AS MENU_USE_YN, CASE WHEN AM.MENU_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MAPPED_YN, NVL(AM.QRY_ROL_YN, 'N') AS QRY_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.REG_ROL_YN, 'N') AS REG_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.UPD_ROL_YN, 'N') AS UPD_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.DEL_ROL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.EXE_ROL_YN, 'N') AS EXE_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.USE_YN, 'N') AS USE_YN, AM.CRT_DTM, AM.CRT_CMENO, AM.LSCHG_DTM, AM.LS_CMENO FROM TB_SCR_MENU M LEFT JOIN TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU AM ON AM.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND AM.AUTH = #{auth} ORDER BY M.PARENT_MENU_ID, M.SORT_NO, M.MENU_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU ( AUTH, MENU_ID, QRY_ROL_YN, REG_ROL_YN, UPD_ROL_YN, DEL_ROL_YN, EXE_ROL_YN, USE_YN, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{auth}, #{menuId}, #{qryRolYn}, #{regRolYn}, #{updRolYn}, #{delRolYn}, #{exeRolYn}, #{useYn}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU SET QRY_ROL_YN = #{qryRolYn}, REG_ROL_YN = #{regRolYn}, UPD_ROL_YN = #{updRolYn}, DEL_ROL_YN = #{delRolYn}, EXE_ROL_YN = #{exeRolYn}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE AUTH = #{auth} AND MENU_ID = #{menuId}
